items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I bought the house that I'm living in from Eddie Mallory.

ctx.x: They used to be at the Arcadia Ballroom years ago.

And he played with Fats. And then, you know, he and Eddie Mallory were in partnership there with Fat Mans in the Bronx here. In fact the one in Manhattan, too. And Eddie, I bought the house that I'm living in from Eddie Mallory.
